name: AP2127
description: Small modern CMOS LDO in SOT-23-5 (also SOT-23-3 and SOT-89), adjustable 0.8V-5.5V via an external divider or fixed-output grade, 300mA continuous. Used as the adjustable-rail regulator on the Bus Pirate 5 (AP2127K-ADJTRG1). Low dropout (170mV typ at 300mA for a 3.3V output) and low quiescent current make it typical of the tiny modern LDOs that have largely replaced classic 78xx/AMS1117-style regulators on compact boards.

pins.name: EN
pins.description: shutdown/enable; logic high enables the output

pins.name: ADJ
pins.description: feedback input for the adjustable grade; connect a resistor divider from VOUT. Fixed-output grades leave this as NC

SOT-23-5.notes: Per Diodes Inc's own pin table (SOT-23-5 column): VIN=1, GND=2, EN=3, ADJ/NC=4, VOUT=5. The same die also ships in SOT-23-3 and SOT-89 with different pin assignments per package, always check which package column applies.

typical_application: Small adjustable local rail regulation on space-constrained boards; used for the Bus Pirate 5's adjustable-voltage output stage.
gotchas: adjustable grade (ADJTRG1 suffix used on Bus Pirate 5) needs an external resistor divider from VOUT to the ADJ pin, bare VOUT alone will not regulate
EN is active HIGH; tie to VIN if always-on operation is wanted, do not float
pin assignment differs by package (SOT-23-3 vs SOT-23-5 vs SOT-89); this entry documents SOT-23-5 specifically, the package used on Bus Pirate 5
300mA continuous is the typical rating; the 400mA figure is a max/peak spec, do not design a continuous load around it
